title: Aquaglyceroporin-3's Expression and Cellular Localization Is Differentially Modulated by Hypoxia in Prostate Cancer Cell Lines.
authors: de Almeida, Andreia; Parthimos, Dimitris; Dew, Holly; Smart, Oliver; Wiltshire, Marie; Errington, Rachel J
one_liner_zh: 该文研究前列腺癌细胞中水通道蛋白AQP3在缺氧下的表达与定位，仅用机器学习分类细胞形态特征，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Aquaporins are required by cells to enable fast adaptation to volume and osmotic changes, as well as microenvironmental metabolic stimuli. Aquaglyceroporins play a crucial role in supplying cancer cells with glycerol for metabolic needs. Here, we show that AQP3 is differentially expressed in cells of a prostate cancer panel. AQP3 is located at the cell membrane and cytoplasm of LNCaP cell while being exclusively expressed in the cytoplasm of Du145 and PC3 cells. LNCaP cells show enhanced hypoxia growth; Du145 and PC3 cells display stress factors, indicating a crucial role for AQP3 at the plasma membrane in adaptation to hypoxia. Hypoxia, both acute and chronic affected AQP3's cellular localization. These outcomes were validated using a machine learning classification approach of the three cell lines and of the six normoxic or hypoxic conditions. Classifiers trained on morphological features derived from cytoskeletal and nuclear labeling alongside corresponding texture features could uniquely identify each individual cell line and the corresponding hypoxia exposure. Cytoskeletal features were 70-90% accurate, while nuclear features allowed for 55-70% accuracy. Cellular texture features (73.9% accuracy) were a stronger predictor of the hypoxic load than the AQP3 distribution (60.3%).
abstract_zh: 水通道蛋白是细胞快速适应体积和渗透压变化以及微环境代谢刺激所必需的。水甘油通道蛋白在向癌细胞提供甘油以满足代谢需求方面发挥着关键作用。在此，我们表明AQP3在前列腺癌细胞系组中差异表达。AQP3定位于LNCaP细胞的细胞膜和细胞质，而在Du145和PC3细胞中仅表达于细胞质。LNCaP细胞表现出增强的低氧生长；Du145和PC3细胞显示应激因子，表明质膜上的AQP3在适应低氧中起关键作用。急性和慢性低氧均影响AQP3的细胞定位。这些结果通过使用机器学习分类方法对三种细胞系及六种常氧或低氧条件进行了验证。基于细胞骨架和核标记衍生的形态学特征及其相应纹理特征训练的分类器能够唯一识别每种细胞系及相应的低氧暴露。细胞骨架特征的准确率为70-90%，而核特征的准确率为55-70%。细胞纹理特征（准确率73.9%）比AQP3分布（60.3%）更能预测低氧负荷。
